newsitem.title: CHINA: Shanghai bourse to close on Monday, Tuesday.
newsitem.headline: Shanghai bourse to close on Monday, Tuesday.

text.p: The Shanghai Stock Exchange will be closed on Monday and Tuesday next week to mark the Chinese takeover of Hong Kong, the exchange said in a statement on Friday.
Trading will resume on Wednesday, the statement said.
On Friday, Shanghai's foreign currency B share index fell 0.651 points or 0.79 percent to 81.478 points. The domestic A share index lost 36.421 points or 2.71 percent to 1,306.778.
